_comment: Least-privilege policy for the deploy user. Replace BUCKET_NAME, and ACCOUNT_ID + DISTRIBUTION_ID if you use CloudFront. Deliberately excludes s3:DeleteBucket and s3:PutBucketPolicy so a deploy can never destroy the bucket itself.

Statement._comment: Optional: lets the deploy script confirm which identity it is using via sts get-caller-identity. sts:GetCallerIdentity takes no resource and cannot be restricted.
